description: Jira client whose output is a versioned contract, for scripts and agents
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "jr could not write its skill into $skill" }
notes: jr's agent skill is in ~\.claude\skills\jr, written by the binary it describes, and
'scoop update jr' rewrites it at the new version. 'scoop uninstall jr' leaves it there.
jr refuses to write it into a directory holding a file the skill does not include.
